title: 3권 5유닛 스토리북 · 3쪽
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. Full-page picture-book illustration. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Pip, Grumble. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: From high in the giant tree, Grumble gives his biggest Shh! and Pip, copying him, says the sound in one smooth breath for the first time: Pip glows bright gold with sparkles bursting from its beak, the first door flings open with a rush of leaves, and everyone jumps and cheers. Later, at dusk, Grumble sits on a low branch holding his lantern up to light the path, smiling a small proud smile. Far off in the trees, a big round wall clock with no numbers hangs on a trunk, its hands stopped. Hidden in the picture: the fish, the shop, the ring on the Duck King, the song notes. (The little king is the Duck King: a small yellow duck with a tiny golden crown — an animal, not a human.) Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
